title: Momentum, Collisions and Safety
summary: Momentum p = mv, conservation of momentum in collisions and recoil, and why airbags and crumple zones save lives.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 6: How Forces Affect Motion
Earlier NCERT: Force and Laws of Motion

objectives: I can calculate momentum using p = mv.
I can apply conservation of momentum to collisions and explosions.
I can explain how increasing stopping time reduces force.
misconceptions: Momentum is lost when objects stick together.
A heavy object always has more momentum than a light one.
Airbags work by reducing your momentum before a crash.
